jobs.name: spielberg-buffer-refill-daily
jobs.prompt:
Tales Untold Shorts Buffer Refill — Daily Edition

GOAL: keep the Tales Untold YouTube Buffer queue stocked so shorts post exactly 3x per day at 6:00 PM, 7:00 PM, 8:00 PM America/New_York, every single day with no gaps.

IMPORTANT CONSTRAINT discovered 2026-09-17: Buffer's Tales Untold org plan caps SCHEDULED posts at 10 total, account-wide. You cannot schedule further ahead than that. This means at 3 posts/day, you can only ever look ~3 days ahead before hitting the cap — do NOT try to fill a full 4-day window like earlier versions of this job did. Always check the actual cap via step 1 before attempting to schedule anything.

STEP 1 - Check current coverage AND remaining slot budget:
python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/buffer_dual_account.py check tales_untold
List every SCHEDULED post's dueAt (convert from UTC to America/New_York) and count the total. Remaining budget = 10 - current_scheduled_count. If remaining budget is 0, report "Buffer at 10/10 cap, no room to schedule more today" and stop (skip steps 3-6) — this is normal and will resolve itself as older posts publish.

STEP 2 - Determine how many new posts are needed, bounded by budget:
Identify which of the next 3 days' 6/7/8 PM ET slots are empty (a slot counts as filled if a post's dueAt is within +/- 5 minutes of 18:00, 19:00, or 20:00 ET that day). Needed = count of empty slots in that 3-day window. Actually produce = min(needed, remaining budget from step 1). If actually_produce is 0, report "queue healthy" and stop.

STEP 3 - Story Topic Generation (only if needed):
Check ~/.openclaw/workspace/tales-untold/queue/ folder. If fewer unused topics exist than actually_produce, write new horror micro-story topics (one-liners, 140-180 word target when expanded) and save as queue/XX_topic_name.txt files (XX = next available two-digit number).

STEP 4 - Title A/B variant + Video Production (per the spielberg skill, updated 2026-09-17):
For each new video (up to actually_produce), before writing/finalizing its title run: python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/tales_ab_tracker.py next
This returns "A" (direct first-person hook) or "B" (third-person retrospective-reveal hook). Write the title to match. This is a running A/B test — see references/title-and-metadata-strategy.md in the spielberg skill.

Produce videos SERIALLY, one full pipeline at a time, never in parallel — parallel dispatch caused real race conditions (duplicate topic claims, file collisions) on 2026-09-17. Produce FINAL_*.mp4 files, upload each to Google Drive folder 1EbHh1_zhHDVX2YAO2i7yV_3epwUvNppj using /home/herby/.hermes/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/upload_video_to_drive.py <path> (not the tales-untold venv). After each render, verify faststart (moov before mdat); if the file is large (>50MB) or fails this check, re-encode: ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart out.mp4 (target under 25MB).

STEP 5 - Verify Drive URL, then schedule with EXACT times and updated metadata:
Before scheduling, verify the Drive URL downloads as a real video: curl -sL '<url>' -o /tmp/verify.bin --max-time 30 -w '%{content_type} %{size_download}\n' then file /tmp/verify.bin -- must show video/mp4, not text/html (a large non-faststart file triggers Google's virus-scan warning page instead of the real video).

Build the description using the no-hashtag, cross-promotion pattern: one hook line (no hashtags, no #shorts #horror #creepypasta stuffing) followed by "Subscribe for more Tales Untold, short and long form horror." on its own line. Do NOT pass any tags field.

Call:
  python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/buffer_dual_account.py post-youtube "TITLE" "DRIVE_URL" "HOOK_LINE
Subscribe for more Tales Untold, short and long form horror." "DUE_AT_UTC_ISO8601"

DUE_AT_UTC_ISO8601 must be the exact UTC equivalent of that slot's 6/7/8 PM ET time. ALWAYS pass this 4th argument explicitly. If Buffer rejects with a "Limit reached" / scheduled-posts-cap error even though step 1's count suggested room (race condition with another process), stop immediately, report the actual error, and do NOT delete or bump any existing post without asking the user first.

Verify each post landed at the correct time by re-running the check command after scheduling and confirming the dueAt matches within 5 minutes.

STEP 6 - Log the A/B result:
Once a post is confirmed scheduled and you can identify its underlying video ID (via the Buffer check output's post id, which is sufficient if the true YouTube video ID isn't resolvable pre-publish), log it: python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/tales_ab_tracker.py log <id> <A|B> "<title>"

Report: current queue coverage before and after this run (scheduled count out of 10, which of the next 3 days have all 3 slots filled), how many videos were produced/scheduled this run and their titles + variants + exact scheduled times, and whether it's been ~2 weeks since the A/B test started (if so, remind the user to run `python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/tales_ab_tracker.py report`). If Spielberg production fails for any topic, report the failure clearly and do not schedule a placeholder or invented video in its place.

jobs.name: tales-shorts-slot2-followup

Context: Buffer's Tales Untold org caps scheduled posts at 10. Video "The Figure In The Elevator Hallway Was The New Tenant" (topic 11_elevator_stop.txt, A/B variant B) is FULLY PRODUCED and sitting ready — do not re-produce it. It's already rendered, faststart-verified, and uploaded to Google Drive at:
https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1ATqTKAXo0Oo1efvzTmfsQCH7U9qLP3iK

Steps:
1. Run: python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/buffer_dual_account.py check tales_untold
   Confirm current scheduled post count is now below 10 (Thursday 6PM's post should have published by now, freeing a slot). If still at 10/10, wait 10 minutes and check again once; if still blocked after that, report the blocker and stop — do not delete/bump any post without asking.
2. Verify the Drive URL still downloads as real video: curl -sL '<url>' -o /tmp/verify.bin --max-time 30 -w '%{content_type} %{size_download}\n' then file /tmp/verify.bin -- must show video/mp4.
3. Schedule it:
python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/buffer_dual_account.py post-youtube "The Figure In The Elevator Hallway Was The New Tenant | Tales Untold" "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1ATqTKAXo0Oo1efvzTmfsQCH7U9qLP3iK" "The figure standing in the elevator hallway every night was never a resident. 5. Log the A/B result: python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/tales_ab_tracker.py log <post_id> B "The Figure In The Elevator Hallway Was The New Tenant"
